Name: (CP) Stardew Kids Expanded - Ridgeside Village NPC Location Fix
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][u][b]What is it?[/b][/u]
I have a little bit of a perfectionist streak in me, and when I see NPCs overlapping I HAVE to fix them if the mod author is too busy, etc.

This mod specifically changes the position of Flor from[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286] Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ to no longer intersect with Vanessa from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expansion[/url]﻿ when they're both scheduled to be at the right of the community center.
[b]
﻿[/b][u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u]Unzip the .rar file and drag its contents into your mods folder. That's it!

[u][b]Have a request?[/b]
[/u]If you find any schedule overlaps or festival overlaps in any NPC mods, please let me know!
If the creator of the mods has no intention of fixing the issue (most have bigger things to work on!) and I obtain permission, I'll do my best do push out a patch.[/center]
